Discord.Name: Join Discord
Discord.Hint: Join the GlitchSmith Discord server for support, feedback, and updates.

Enabled.Name: Enable Module
Enabled.Hint: Enable or disable the JRPG Field Interaction system.

HeaderButtonsIconOnly.Name: Sheet Header Button: Icon Only
HeaderButtonsIconOnly.Hint: Show Visual Novel Maker's Application V1 actor sheet portrait settings button as an icon without a text label. Useful when a system or multiple modules crowd the sheet header.

PromptDistance.Name: Prompt Distance
PromptDistance.Hint: Grid distance at which interaction prompts appear. (Default: 1)

DefaultTransition.Name: Default Transition
DefaultTransition.Hint: Default screen transition used when opening and closing VN mode.

TypewriterSpeed.Name: Typewriter Speed
TypewriterSpeed.Hint: Characters per second for the typewriter effect. (Default: 30)

TypewriterSound.Name: Typewriter Sound Volume
TypewriterSound.Hint: Volume of the typewriter tick sound. Set to 0 to disable.

TypewriterSoundFile.Name: Typewriter Sound File
TypewriterSoundFile.Hint: Audio file for the typewriter tick effect. Leave default or choose your own.

TypewriterSoundInterval.Name: Typewriter Sound Interval
TypewriterSoundInterval.Hint: Minimum interval (ms) between tick sounds. Lower = more frequent. Adjust based on your sound file. (Default: 60)

InteractionRange.Name: NPC Interaction Range
InteractionRange.Hint: Maximum distance (in grid squares) to interact with NPC tokens. 0 = no limit.

DefaultFramedMode.Name: Default to Framed Mode
DefaultFramedMode.Hint: Automatically enable framed character display when starting a live session.

LockBackground.Name: Lock Background
LockBackground.Hint: Prevent camera movements (zoom, pan, shake) from affecting the background image.

SkipPCSpeaker.Name: Skip PC Speaker Switch
SkipPCSpeaker.Hint: When clicking a PC on the VN stage, the chat speaker will not switch to that PC.

LiveHideDialogue.Name: Live Mode: Hide Dialogue Box
LiveHideDialogue.Hint: Hides the dialogue box in live mode. Useful for voice play sessions where only background and character visuals are needed.

PerCharacterDialoguePanels.Name: Per-Character Dialogue Panels
PerCharacterDialoguePanels.Hint: When enabled, staged actors get their own slots in a connected bottom dialogue bar, each with its own name label. Narration and system lines keep using the shared dialogue box. Falls back to the shared box when the speaker is not on stage. Default off.

HideCharacterDockNames.Name: Hide Character Names in Top Bar
HideCharacterDockNames.Hint: Hide the name labels below character portraits in the top bar for all users. Character portraits and dialogue speaker names remain visible. Useful when an NPC's identity has not been revealed yet.

LockPlayerCharAdd.Name: Lock Player Character Add
LockPlayerCharAdd.Hint: When enabled, players cannot add their own characters to the stage. Only the GM can add characters.
LockPlayerCharAdd.Locked: Players cannot add characters to the stage.

LockPlayerStageControls.Name: Lock Player Stage Controls
LockPlayerStageControls.Hint: Prevent players from moving, scaling, resetting, flipping, hiding, changing expressions, effects, or emotions, and removing their staged characters. Players can still select their character as the chat speaker.
LockPlayerStageControls.Locked: The GM has locked player stage controls.

VoiceIndicator.Name: Live Mode: Voice Highlight
VoiceIndicator.Hint: Automatically highlights each user's selected VN character through microphone detection, falling back to their assigned character when none is selected. Enabling this may prompt the browser for microphone access.

InactiveCharacterDim.Name: Inactive Character Dimming
InactiveCharacterDim.Hint: Controls how much non-active stage characters are dimmed when another character is highlighted. The active character keeps its glow and z-index regardless.

LipSyncMode.Name: Lip Image Mode
LipSyncMode.Hint: Choose whether dialogue, chat, and microphone voice activity alternate lip frames or hold the speaking image while a character is talking.

AdaptiveUiScale.Name: Adaptive UI Scaling
AdaptiveUiScale.Hint: Scale the visual novel stage UI to match your screen size (designed at 1920×1080). Disable to keep fixed pixel sizes.

ChoiceMode.Name: Choice Mode
ChoiceMode.Hint: Choose whether choices resolve instantly or through player voting.

Theme.Name: Dialogue Theme
Theme.Hint: Select the visual theme for the VN overlay.

OverlayConfig.Name: Overlay Customize
OverlayConfig.Label: Open Settings
OverlayConfig.Hint: Customize the appearance of VN overlay elements such as dialogue box, nameplate, and choices.
